bio.text: Jason Pizzo has represented District 37 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2018; the Senate lists Pizzo's party as No Party Affiliation, and Pizzo served as Minority (Democratic) Leader from 2024 to April 24, 2025.
Pizzo is an attorney and a former assistant state attorney in the Miami-Dade State Attorney's Office.

Pizzo was born in Somerville, New Jersey, and moved to Florida in 2007; Pizzo holds degrees from New York University (B.A., 1999), Columbia University (M.S., 2007) and the University of Miami (J.D., 2010).
